## Hypothesis

The SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE5_VARIATION candidate aims to capture the edge in the 2025-Q3 and 2026-Q1 regimes by utilizing a walk-forward optimized trendline break retest (TBR) strategy with a high-volatility filter. The hypothesis is that this strategy will improve upon the existing SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE5 candidate by incorporating a more robust volatility filter and optimizing the entry and exit parameters.

## Mechanism

The SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE5_VARIATION candidate uses a trendline break retest strategy with the following parameters:

* Entry: Long when the trendline is broken and retested, with a volatility filter to ensure high-volatility environments.
* Exit: Exit when the trendline is re-broken or when a profit target is reached.
* Volatility filter: Use a high-volatility filter to ensure that the strategy only enters trades in high-volatility environments.
